data.gender_notes: Nizaar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root n-z-r, meaning 'to guide' or 'to protect'. In Islamic history, Nizaris are a sect of Shia Islam, named after their Imam, Nizar al-Mustansiri Billah. The name is associated with spiritual guidance and protection. The name Nizaar carries the meaning “Guide, Protector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nizaar usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nizaar total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
